messages:
laura: quick heads-up — proposing small audit event shape change to support client-side routing.
laura: removing actor.parent_id (legacy), adding request.origin (string: 'console'|'api'|'sdk'|'internal') and auth_flow enum ('password','token','sso','service_account').
laura: want migration plan + customer-facing validation samples. cc @miguel @aditya

miguel: sounds reasonable. any backwards-compat worries for consumers reading 'parent_id' gone?
miguel: we can emit parent_id for 90 days and add a notice in release notes.

aditya: +1. we should version the schema: audit.v3 -> audit.v4 and include a top-level "event_version":"4"
aditya: suggested rollout: emit both v3 & v4 for 60 days, then cutover.

rebecca: need to update KMS wrapping for actor ids. if we remove parent_id, double-check decryption codepaths.
rebecca: also, telemetry team needs example events to validate ingestion.

laura: good call. I'll draft a small example payload. please sanity-check.

laura: ```
{
  "event_version":"4",
  "timestamp":"2024-11-02T15:22:10Z",
  "actor": {"id":"user_abc","type":"user"},
  "request":{"origin":"sdk","ip":"10.0.0.1"},
  "auth_flow":"sso",
  "action":"model.deploy",
  "metadata":{}
}
```

sam: can we include a compatibility header so proxies can route? maybe "x-audit-schema":"4"
sam: Also add a migration flag for customers who need extended overlap.

sec-bot: NOTE: security policy requires retention of actor provenance. if we drop parent_id, ensure actor.hints includes legacy_parent_id or hashed_parent so we keep prov info.

miguel: ok let's do this plan: (1) emit v4 + legacy_parent_id for 90 days, (2) publish docs + sample data, (3) notify top 20 customers and add feature flag, (4) run consumer validation job.

aditya: timeline? can we target next Wednesday for GA announcement and two-week beta?

laura: timeline sounds tight but doable. I'll create PR with schema docs + migration checklist by EOD tomorrow.
laura: owners: laura (schema), miguel (client samples), rebecca (kms/decrypt), aditya (rollout), sam (flagging & proxy).

miguel: noted. ping me when draft's up, I'll run sample ingest tests.

laura: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
